lab: IOS Line and Local User Authentication
topology: PC1 is the permitted management source on R1 Gi0/0. PC2 reaches R1 Gi0/2 but is denied by a VTY-only source ACL. Both retain independent routed data access to SRV1 behind Gi0/1.
implemented: New sixth ENCOR section Security with one lab and an accessible singular count; original CCNA Local User Authentication stays in Services & Security.
Temporary shared console and Telnet line-password stage requires an actual rejected password and successful login in each same session.
Protected console EXEC logout now clears identity/privilege, waits for Return and restarts configured line/local authentication. Ctrl-C cannot skip a local login prompt.
Local console authentication exercises both privilege1 operator and privilege15 administrator with real failed/successful hidden-password input.

SSH operator authentication requires wrong-password rejection, actual privilege1 login and configuration denial. The separate enable secret rejects the matching legacy enable password, elevates to15 and disable returns to1.
Administrator SSH enters privilege15 directly. SSH-only VTY transport must then refuse a real Telnet handshake.
All sixteen VTYs require local login, SSH-only transport, no shared password or line privilege bypass, a five-minute timeout and the exact LOCAL-MGMT source ACL.
PC2 VTY refusal requires actual access-class enforcement, fresh PC2 server echo replies and a fresh permitted PC1 administrator login; interface ACL shortcuts cannot satisfy final topology.

A temporary ten-second VTY timer expires an authenticated session despite normal status polling. Typed commands refresh activity; zero disables expiry. The lab restores five minutes and requires fresh operator authentication.
Both SSH identities must log out and no VTY sessions remain for clean closure and startup-save credit.

Credential-free console/VTY/enable/denial/timeout/closure observations are bounded256 per current device runtime. Read-only snapshots are copied; portable save/load discards sessions and observations while retaining earned achievements.

Practice starts0/18. Completed reference has seven live configuration tasks and no pre-earned login, traffic or incident evidence. Unknown criteria, foreign roots and missing teaching interfaces fail closed.
scope: IOS line passwords, local users and enable authentication without aaa new-model; centralized AAA is covered by separate catalog labs.
SSH cryptography and IOS password hashing are logical teaching models. Console automatic idle expiry is not exercised or newly configured by this lab; actual VTY expiry is verified.
Primary Cisco documentation reviewed; no new live CML capture was performed.
Terminal styling, existing UI theme and node artwork are unchanged.
